title: Read-only Claude reviewers cannot run `engram source --root ROOT --json`, so they cannot read the candidate's source_id
outcome: Read-only Claude reviewers cannot run `engram source --root ROOT --json`, so they cannot read the candidate's source_id
acceptance: The read-only Claude Bash gate admits `engram source --root <its review root> --json` for a read-only Claude review child on a clean and on a dirty review root, shown by a behavioural test of the gate's allow decision; the live run in the restarted build is tracked as w-e5430c654802.

The read-only Bash gate still refuses every other `engram` subcommand and every `engram source` form that names a root outside the child's review root, writes a file, or passes an option other than `--root` and `--json`; an appended empty word is tracked separately as w-e05775df7960.
Focused tests of the read-only Bash gate cover the accepted form and the refused forms, through observable allow/refuse decisions.
